in_hebrew.name: Fenella
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fenella הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Celtic words ‘fionn’ and ‘ella’, meaning ‘fair one’ or ‘maiden’. In Irish mythology, Fenella was a goddess of beauty and fertility.

in_greek.name: Fenella
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Fair one
in_greek.long_meaning: Fenella είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Celtic words ‘fionn’ and ‘ella’, meaning ‘fair one’ or ‘maiden’. In Irish mythology, Fenella was a goddess of beauty and fertility.

in_latin.name: Fenella
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Fair one
in_latin.long_meaning: Fenella est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Celtic words ‘fionn’ and ‘ella’, meaning ‘fair one’ or ‘maiden’. In Irish mythology, Fenella was a goddess of beauty and fertility.
